about:0021: A Malaysian retail story built around people, everyday essentials and lasting value.
about:0023: Discover the Heart of a Proud Malaysian Retail Legacy
about:0024: At Billion Group, we are more than just a name in the retail industry. Established in 1985, we are a proud homegrown Malaysian brand that has grown alongside the communities we serve.
about:0025: From our humble beginnings, we've expanded across Peninsular Malaysia, with a strategic presence in the Central, Southern, East Coast, Perak, and Northern regions.
about:0030: Behind every number is a community, a partnership and a shared commitment to better everyday shopping.
about:0038: Fresh Market, Seafood, Supermarket, Softline and Hardline
about:0039: However, we are more than just the products we offer. The history and evolution of our brands, Billion and Pantai Timor, have unique stories that shaped our success and vision. What makes us different? Why do we stand out in the market?
about:0041: What started as a humble shopping centre in Kajang soon grew into something much larger. Over four decades, we have expanded across Peninsular Malaysia, opening new locations to bring our trusted shopping experience to communities far and wide.
about:0042: Our network includes not only our original shopping centre but also hypermarkets and convenience stores that cater to the diverse needs of our customers.
about:0043: As we marked our 40th anniversary, we reflected on the journey with pride. From our beginnings in Kajang to our growth across the country, we’ve remained dedicated to offering exceptional value and convenience to everyone who walks through our doors.
about:0044: The success we’ve achieved over the years is a testament to our strong relationships with our customers, partners, and retail community.
about:0045: Thank you for being part of our journey. Here’s to 40 years of milestones and many more years of success as we continue to grow and serve customers across Peninsular Malaysia.
about:0046: A trusted promise, from Kajang to communities throughout Peninsular Malaysia.
about:0049: Our business is expanding and our teams are working on bigger projects to transform the business, leveraging on technology to further improve our services to create awesomeness of customer experience.
about:0050: We aim to bring convenience to local residents, families and friends.
about:0051: Closer to our communities, every day.
about:0052: Convenience, quality and value remain at the heart of our next chapter.
about:0054: The true essence of Billion and Pantai Timor is waiting to be discovered. Each brand has its own story, legacy, and values that have contributed to the success of Billion Group. Curious to learn more about where we come from and where we're heading?
about:0056: Our proud homegrown Malaysian retail heritage.
about:0057: We are a Proud Homegrown Malaysian Retail Brand
about:0058: As a leading homegrown retail company in Malaysia, we take immense pride in our rich heritage and strong foundations that have guided our growth over the years. Established in 1985, we began our journey with a simple yet powerful vision — to provide high-quality products and exceptional customer service to the communities we serve. Over the years, this vision has evolved into a commitment to become a key player in Malaysia's retail industry.
about:0059: From our humble beginnings, we have steadily expanded our presence across Peninsular Malaysia, earning a reputation for reliability and value. With a strong foothold in key regions such as the Central, Southern, East Coast, Perak, and Northern areas, we are proud to have established ourselves as a trusted name in retail, serving millions of customers and touching every corner of the nation.
about:0060: Our diverse portfolio, which includes everything from hypermarkets and supermarkets to convenience stores, reflects our ability to adapt to changing market demands while staying true to our commitment to quality. Our strategic positioning in these regions has allowed us to effectively cater to the varied needs of customers across different communities, ensuring that we are always within reach, offering products and services that make a meaningful impact in everyday lives.
about:0061: Through decades of growth, innovation, and a customer-centric approach, we have not only built a business but a lasting legacy that continues to thrive and evolve. Our ability to adapt to regional preferences, coupled with a nationwide network of outlets, positions us as a cornerstone in the retail sector, always striving to provide the best shopping experience for all Malaysians.
about:0064: Rooted in the East Coast, connected to the community.
about:0065: We are a Proud Homegrown Malaysian Retail Brand
about:0066: On the East Coast of Malaysia, we proudly operate under the Pantai Timor brand, a decision rooted in our commitment to better engage with the local community and meet their specific needs. By using the Pantai Timor name, we are able to tailor our services and offerings to resonate with the distinct preferences of this region, fostering a stronger sense of local connection and trust.
about:0067: Whether through our commitment to competitive pricing, quality goods, or exceptional customer service, the Pantai Timor brand represents our dedication to delivering an outstanding shopping experience, grounded in the values of trust, reliability, and community focus — values that have been the cornerstone of the Billion Group since its inception.
about:0068: This regional identity allows us to be more attuned to the cultural and economic landscape of the East Coast, ensuring that our customers feel closer to the brand and confident in their shopping experience. At the same time, we remain a proud part of the Billion Group, continuously upholding the same high standards of service, product quality, and value that our name is renowned for across Malaysia.

news-malacca:0021: Billion Group Expands into Malacca Market Through Strategic Partnerships
news-malacca:0022: Billion Group marks its entry into Malacca with strategic partnerships for Klebang Cove Residensi and Taman Sutera Wangi.
news-malacca:0023: Representatives displaying signed Memoranda of Understanding at the Billion Group Malacca partnership ceremony.
news-malacca:0024: 11 April 2026 – Billion Group is proud to announce the successful Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signing ceremony, marking a significant milestone in the Group’s strategic expansion into the Malacca market.
news-malacca:0025: Held on 11 April 2026, the MOU signing ceremony formalised new partnerships for two landmark projects: Klebang Cove Residensi and Taman Sutera Wangi. This development represents an important step in establishing Billion Group’s presence in Malacca and extending its retail offerings to a new community.
news-malacca:0026: With a heritage of 40 years built on trust and value, Billion Group continues to pursue opportunities to serve regional and growing markets across the nation. The Group’s entry into Malacca reflects its ongoing commitment to bringing convenient retail solutions closer to the communities it serves.
news-malacca:0027: Through these new partnerships, Billion Group aims to establish a convenient, one-stop retail destination for residents of Klebang Cove Residensi and Taman Sutera Wangi. By integrating grocery and lifestyle offerings, the Group seeks to support the everyday needs of local families and provide a convenient shopping destination right at their doorstep.
news-malacca:0030: The expansion marks Billion Group’s first outlet in Malacca, establishing the brand’s presence in a new market and opening the way to connect with the local community.
news-malacca:0032: Through its planned retail presence serving Klebang Cove Residensi and Taman Sutera Wangi, Billion Group aims to bring grocery and lifestyle offerings closer to residents, supporting their daily needs through a convenient one-stop retail destination.
news-malacca:0034: This milestone reflects Billion Group’s continued efforts to expand into regional and growing markets nationwide, building on its 40-year heritage of trust and value while reaching new communities.
news-malacca:0035: Billion Group extends its sincere appreciation to its partners for their trust in the Billion brand and for making this milestone possible. The Group looks forward to building strong partnerships, connecting with the Malacca community and empowering its new brand partners in the region.
news-malacca:0036: As Billion Group continues its expansion journey, this milestone represents another step forward in its mission to serve communities through convenient retail offerings and trusted value.

news-malacca:0039: Partnership representatives exchanging a handshake and signed agreement folders.

news-segamat:0021: Pasaraya Billion Segamat to Cease Operations on 15 November 2026
news-segamat:0022: A notice dated 4 September outlines the closure and clearance schedule for Pasaraya Billion Segamat.
news-segamat:0023: Exterior of Pasaraya Billion Segamat. Photograph credited to Segamat Group.
news-segamat:0024: 12 September 2026 – Pasaraya Billion, located along Jalan Ros in Segamat, is reported to be ceasing operations on 15 November 2026, according to information shared in a notice dated 4 September 2026.
news-segamat:0025: The decision follows Billion’s decision not to renew the lease agreement with the property owner. In line with the closure arrangements, all tenants and resellers operating within the premises have been requested to vacate their respective spaces according to the designated schedule.
news-segamat:0026: The notice outlines several phases leading up to the complete handover of the premises, covering the clearance sale period, the removal of tenants’ belongings and stock, and the final clearance of the remaining spaces.
news-segamat:0029: A clearance sale will take place during this period, running until the store’s final day of operation on 15 November 2026. All sales activities will cease once operations officially end on that date.
news-segamat:0031: Following the cessation of business operations, tenants will be required to vacate their respective spaces and remove their equipment, fixtures and stock from the premises.
news-segamat:0033: The final phase will involve completing the remaining clearance work to ensure that all spaces are vacated and the premises are returned to the property owner by 10 December 2026 at the latest.
news-segamat:0035: Pasaraya Billion Segamat has long been part of the local business landscape, serving as one of the commercial premises familiar to the Segamat community.
news-segamat:0036: The reported closure marks a change for the premises, which has been part of the area’s business environment for many years. News of the upcoming cessation of operations has prompted reactions among members of the local community, with residents reflecting on their experiences and memories associated with Billion Segamat.
news-segamat:0037: As the scheduled closure date approaches, the premises will enter its final period of sales before the subsequent vacating and handover process takes place.
news-segamat:0038: Billion Segamat’s longstanding presence has made it a familiar name within the local community, and its upcoming closure invites residents to look back on the memories and experiences they have shared at the premises.
news-segamat:0039: Source: Information and photographs credited to Segamat Group. The closure details and schedule are based on the notice dated 4 September 2026, as reported in the original shared post.

news-utar-scholarship:0021: UTAR and Billion Shopping Centre (Semenyih) Sdn Bhd launch scholarship collaboration to expand opportunity and strengthen industry-ready talent
news-utar-scholarship:0022: The Billion Scholarship Programme connects educational opportunity with practical industry experience.
news-utar-scholarship:0023: Mr Lee Yung Sen (left) and Prof Dato’ Ewe holding the signed MoA.
news-utar-scholarship:0024: UTAR took a meaningful step in advancing student opportunity and industry-integrated education through the signing of a memorandum of agreement (MoA) with Billion Shopping Centre (Semenyih) Sdn Bhd on 13 April 2026 at UTAR Sungai Long Campus. Centred on the Billion Scholarship Programme, the collaboration reflects a shared commitment to supporting high-potential students, strengthening graduate readiness, and creating stronger connections between higher education and industry.
news-utar-scholarship:0025: The partnership goes beyond financial assistance. By combining tuition fee support with structured internship opportunities, the programme is designed to help students pursue their studies with greater confidence while gaining the practical exposure needed to thrive in a competitive professional environment. It also reinforces UTAR’s commitment to producing graduates who are academically strong, professionally prepared and capable of contributing meaningfully to industry and society.
news-utar-scholarship:0026: Under the agreement, Billion Shopping Centre (Semenyih) Sdn Bhd will sponsor a total of 16 students over a three-year period, comprising eight students entering or in Year 2 and eight students entering or in Year 3. Each selected student will receive up to RM16,000 per annum in tuition fee support, subject to the programme’s terms and conditions. The scholarship is open to Malaysian full-time undergraduate students from selected programmes, including retail management, business administration, logistics and supply chain management, marketing, accounting, communication, graphic design and multimedia, as well as occupational safety and health with environmental health. Priority will be given to students who demonstrate both academic merit and genuine financial need.
news-utar-scholarship:0027: A key feature of the programme is the inclusion of a mandatory internship placement of at least three months with Billion Shopping Centre (Semenyih) Sdn Bhd. This component will allow sponsored students to apply classroom knowledge in a real business setting, gain industry insights and develop workplace competencies that are increasingly valued by employers. The integration of sponsorship and experiential learning reflects a more holistic approach to talent development, one that supports not only access to education but also long-term employability.
news-utar-scholarship:0028: In his speech, UTAR President Ir Prof Dato’ Dr Ewe Hong Tat described the occasion as an important milestone in the shared commitment of both parties to education, opportunity and student empowerment. He noted that while education has the power to transform lives and uplift communities, many capable students still face financial barriers in pursuing higher education. He added that partnerships such as this are vital in ensuring that deserving students are given the support they need to succeed, while also broadening their learning journey through practical industry exposure.
news-utar-scholarship:0029: The ceremony brought together key representatives from both UTAR and Billion Shopping Centre (Semenyih) Sdn Bhd, reflecting the strategic importance of the collaboration. Representing Billion were Chairman of Billion Group Mr Lee Yung Sen, Financial cum IT Administrator Mr Albert Chuah, Operation Director of Billion Group Mr Tan He Khon, Managing Director of Billion Group Mr Wong Chee Leong, Sales and Marketing Director of Billion Group Mr Leong Teik Ee, Group Executive Director of Billion Group Mr Lee Siew Hung, Employer Branding and Marketing Manager Mr Koo Siong Ann, and Employer Branding and Marketing Executive Ms Sofea.
news-utar-scholarship:0030: A group photo with representatives of UTAR and Billion Shopping Centre (Semenyih) Sdn Bhd.
news-utar-scholarship:0031: Representing UTAR were its President Ir Prof Dato’ Dr Ewe Hong Tat, Dean of the Faculty of Accountancy and Management Assoc Prof Dr Pok Wei Fong, Deputy Dean of the Faculty of Creative Industries Assoc Prof Thinavan Periyayya, Head of the Department of Multimedia Design and Animation Dr Wan Irma Sabrina binti Idris, and Head of the Department of Scholarships and Financial Aid Ms Tan Wear Sim. Their presence underscored the collective resolve of both organisations to build an impactful collaboration that will benefit students while deepening engagement between academia and industry.
news-utar-scholarship:0032: The Billion Scholarship Programme is expected to deliver tangible value on multiple fronts. For students, it offers meaningful financial support, structured workplace learning and stronger career pathways. For industry, it creates opportunities to engage with emerging talent early and contribute to the development of a capable graduate pipeline. For UTAR, the collaboration strengthens its strategic focus on purposeful partnerships that enhance student outcomes, elevate industry relevance and reinforce the University’s position as an institution committed to quality, innovation and future-ready education.
news-utar-scholarship:0033: As UTAR continues to expand collaborations that create measurable educational and societal impact, the MoA with Billion Shopping Centre (Semenyih) Sdn Bhd stands as a strong example of how shared vision can be translated into meaningful opportunity. By aligning sponsorship with experiential learning, the initiative will widen access for deserving students while supporting the development of well-rounded graduates equipped for the demands of a dynamic economy.
